lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like formation of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and numerous vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the highest intensity local maxima positioned in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to create a rectilinear anchor-node pattern, most discernible in the region between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank; the dorsal-most ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the upper edge and a distinct shadow-cast gradient on the lower edge.
